name: D1 offline action timing for next-packet forecasts
scope: Development comparison on the previously examined round-101 archive. No rollout, policy or current terrain-readout update. A pass applies to recorded-action forecasts only.
frozen_representation: For each seed both arms use its same round-101 predictive checkpoint, fixed normalizers, history state and 32 depth plus 8 body target features. The current observer only receives the same delivered sensors and its previous two issued actions.
variable: Change only the time origin of an ordered, equal-length action block supplied to the auxiliary forecast heads. For consecutive capture boundaries c,c+g and deliveries d=c+2,d+g, g is 8 or 9 policy ticks. At modality boundary t (c for depth, d for body), past gets [t-g,t), transition gets [t,t+g). All blocks use the 16 issued action components and one validity bit per tick, with zero padding at the end to 9 slots. No cross-episode pairs. An action issued at the target boundary is excluded.

data.source_action_slice: [16,152) within each complete native flat episode; corroborate all issued[step] against proprio627[step+1,41:57]. Duplicated scene layouts or visibility views retain one underlying trajectory.

fit.trainable: Two separate heads per arm, each receives frozen hidden32 plus flat 9x17 actions/validity, uses a 32-unit tanh layer, then outputs 32 depth or 8 body components. Initialized from identical tensors within seed. No change to encoder, current height estimate, whole-body policy, PD, curriculum or reward.
fit.loss: One half the sum of the per-component depth and body mean squared errors to the frozen next packet features.
fit.optimizer: Adam lr 0.003, betas (0.9,0.999), eps 1e-8, zero weight decay, foreach false; clip gradient norm at 1.
fit.batches: Successor rows only. For each seed, shuffle the 960 rows in complete epochs with NumPy default_rng(seed) and take the first 50 full batches of 48; both arms use the same schedule.

gate: Evaluate all 3 seeds separately, both modalities. On masked views, each transition-window MSE must be at most 0.95 times its matched positive past-window MSE and strictly below carrying the current embedding forward. On clear views neither modality may increase MSE relative to its matched past window. All seeds must pass. Report per-seed, per-visibility, per-modality and per-native-episode measurements. Fixed common targets within seed. No ranking, removing rows or pooling seeds to pass.
